prompt_template: Latitude: {lat:.1f}, Longitude: {lon:.1f}. Predict the surface type (Solid or Water) and terrain elevation in meters relative to mean sea level (EGM2008). Solid includes land and grounded ice: report bare-ground elevation, or the ice-surface elevation on grounded ice. Water includes oceans, lakes, and floating ice shelves: report the seabed or lakebed elevation, NOT the water or floating-ice surface elevation. Underwater terrain below sea level has a negative elevation. Ignore buildings, vegetation, and temporary sea ice. Reply with exactly one JSON object with two fields: "type" ("Solid" or "Water") and "elevation_m" (a single number in meters, not a range).
